### Problem Statement
What problem does this solve for Sri Lankan daters or operators?
*(e.g., "Currently, users traveling between Kandy and Colombo cannot filter their discovery feed by active weekend location...")*

### Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how the feature should behave.

### Target User Persona
- [ ] Working professional in urban centers (Colombo/Galle/Kandy)
- [ ] Traditional/family-conscious dater looking for serious intent
- [ ] Admin / Safety moderator reviewing reports
- [ ] Platform investor / stakeholder

### UI/UX & Cultural Considerations
- How does this respect discretion and neighborhood privacy?
- What micro-interactions or animations should accompany this?
- Does this require translations for Sinhala (`si`) and Tamil (`ta`)?

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
